title: Upgrade Node runtime for Vite 7
description: npm run build succeeds, but Vite warns that Node.js 20.17.0 is below its supported floor of 20.19 or 22.12. Upgrade the local runtime so build and dev server runs are on a supported Node version.

title: Add real tests and style linting
description: The harness now exposes npm run quality, but npm run test is a placeholder and npm run lint is currently a TypeScript static check. Add a real test suite and dedicated style linting so Overstory builders and reviewers have stronger objective gates.

title: Refresh GitNexus index after harness cleanup
description: GitNexus currently reports the veloRail index as stale. After the current harness documentation and script changes are settled, run npx gitnexus analyze and verify npx gitnexus status is current.
